title: School Sports Day
description: Three short recordings about sports day: a talk with a teacher, an announcement and two friends.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Mai and Mr Hall
parts.intro: You will hear Mai talking to her teacher, Mr Hall.

script.speaker: Mr Hall
script.text: Mai, are you ready for sports day?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Yes, sir! I'm in the running race.

script.speaker: Mr Hall
script.text: Which race? The short one or the long one?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: The long one. I wanted the short one, but my friend Lily is faster than me.

script.speaker: Mr Hall
script.text: Don't worry. Remember to wear your red team shirt.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I will. Which team is Lily in?

script.speaker: Mr Hall
script.text: Lily is in the blue team. Good luck!

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I'm a little nervous, but I've practised a lot with my brother in the park.

script.speaker: Mr Hall
script.text: That's the right way to get ready. Remember to drink some water, too.

parts.title: Part 2 · Welcome to sports day
parts.intro: You will hear a teacher at the start of sports day.

script.speaker: Mrs Park
script.text: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to our sports day. We have lots of games today.

script.speaker: Mrs Park
script.text: First, the sack race will start at ten o'clock on the big field. After that, there is a jumping competition.

script.speaker: Mrs Park
script.text: Parents can watch from the benches, but please don't stand on the grass.

script.speaker: Mrs Park
script.text: At twelve o'clock, we'll have a picnic lunch. There's free orange juice for everyone.

script.speaker: Mrs Park
script.text: The prize giving is at two o'clock, and the winners will get a gold star. Thank you!

parts.title: Part 3 · After sports day
parts.intro: You will hear Linh and Nam talking after sports day.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Hi, Nam! Did you enjoy sports day?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Yes, but I fell in the sack race. My knee hurts a bit.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Oh no! Did you win anything?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Yes, I won the jumping competition. I jumped the farthest.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Well done! I came last in the running race, but I wasn't sad. It was fun.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Let's play football tomorrow, then.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Good idea. Meet me at the school gate at four o'clock.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: I'm so tired now. I think I'll go home and sleep for an hour.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Me too. See you later, and say hello to your sister.
